purpose: Thin source-page work queue keyed to frozen CL2 historical_row; not a schedule master, new venue registry, liturgical-book manifest or occurrence publisher.
publication_gates: Exact latest-main CL2 physical site and frozen source-ID joins
First-party page evidence for actual worship venue and Mass—not just devotional time
A local dated bulletin or current operator confirmation for conditional and volatile hours
Reconcile duplicate historical source rows to one real site/day/time occurrence
Explicit ministry/celebration-specific ritual books, communion and canonical assertions; UNKNOWN otherwise
Do not infer public chapel access, Mass type, timezone, celebrant or 1962 books from institute labels
No app import or live timetable publication from this research-only review

reviewed_cases.observation: The institute still publishes Sunday/feast 09:30 Low, 11:00 High, 19:00 Low; Monday 18:30; Tuesday-Friday 07:30 and 18:30; Saturday 07:30 and 11:00.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: ICRSS is named as apostolate operator; no individual-celebration 1962 edition, canonical standing, or Una Cum inference.
reviewed_cases.gate: Check exceptional week or feast bulletin; exact CL2 source ID and duplicate slot reconciliation before publication.

reviewed_cases.observation: Mater Dei lists additional TLM at the Carmelite monastery every day at 07:00, including Sunday. This is distinct from Mater Dei parish's own schedule.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: The Carmelites are the physical community; Mater Dei/FSSP priests are the listed Mass providers. FSSP is not inferred as monastery operator or owner, nor is venue-wide 1962 proof taken from parish-only Mass statement.
reviewed_cases.gate: Confirm monastery public access and priest availability; do not merge Dallas Carmel with Mater Dei parish.

reviewed_cases.observation: The Oratory continues to list Sunday 07:30 Latin, Sunday 10:30 Latin High Mass, and Saturday 09:00 Latin Mass. The page also lists English Masses and weekday Latin times.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: The Oratory is the community; 'Latin' and 'High Mass' alone do not prove exact Roman Missal edition or Solemn minister configuration.
reviewed_cases.gate: Obtain precise liturgical book witness if a 1962 filter is to be published.

reviewed_cases.observation: The Rosariello church section still lists Sunday/feasts 11:00 Sung and 19:00 Low, Monday-Friday 18:30 Low and Saturday 11:00 Low.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: The current page separately names another church, Santa Maria della Sanità a Barra; do not merge their timetables or identify a priest solely by institute.
reviewed_cases.gate: Maintain explicit Rosariello subvenue scope and exclude Ves­pers, Benediction and confession entries from Mass slots.

reviewed_cases.observation: The current Una Voce page lists Sunday 17:00 at Kostel Nanebevzetí Panny Marie a sv. Karla Velikého. Two frozen source IDs represent the same physical church and same Sunday slot.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: Una Voce is an information source; do not infer it owns the church, organises all services, or identifies an individual celebrant.
reviewed_cases.gate: Adjudicate one physical celebration, retaining both immutable historical aliases; source is a national association, not a current dated host bulletin.

reviewed_cases.observation: The site lists both Friday 17:00 and Friday 17:30 for All Saints, Vejprty, and a date-specific programme with varying hours. The historical single Friday 17:30 cannot be treated as a reliable uniform recurrence.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: Mass type and exact liturgical book remain unknown at the individual celebration level.
reviewed_cases.gate: Check live parish calendar/ICS and reconcile both Friday entries; do not synthesize two weekly Masses.

reviewed_cases.observation: The ICRSP Orléans page lists first Sunday of month 18:00 at Saint-Pierre-ès-Liens, explicitly directing readers to verify on the local apostolate site.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: ICRSP is the apostolate source, not proof of venue-wide una cum/canonical status.
reviewed_cases.gate: Obtain local date-specific confirmation; keep first-Sunday condition, never weekly.

reviewed_cases.observation: The ICRSP page lists Sunday/feasts 08:30 at Église Saint-Martin, with explicit instruction to confirm on the local apostolate page.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: ICRSP source community label is scoped to its apostolate; current celebrant and exact Missal not independently established.
reviewed_cases.gate: Local bulletin check required before date-specific event approval.

reviewed_cases.observation: The Oratory currently lists Sunday 11:00 Solemn Mass (Latin), separately from Sunday 08:00 Low Mass (Latin, older form). Weekday 10:00 is expressly suspended for building works.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: Distinguish the source's Solemn/Latin wording from exact Missal edition, which must be independently evidenced for that slot.
reviewed_cases.gate: Do not apply 08:00 'older form' witness automatically to Sunday 11:00, nor publish suspended weekday 10:00.

reviewed_cases.observation: The current SSPX Poland chapel listing states Sunday 12:30 confessions, 13:00 Sung Mass, 14:15 catechism (except holiday months). Both historical 12:30 Mass rows mislabel the confession time.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: SSPX is the operator of this chapel listing. The current source is not a ministry-specific proof of Una Cum or a separate canonical-standing determination.
reviewed_cases.gate: Reject both historical 12:30 Mass occurrences, preserve two source aliases, and admit 13:00 only after exact-source/occurrence duplicate audit.

reviewed_cases.observation: The SSPX district lists Sunday 09:00 OR 14:00, and says to call or consult bulletin. These are alternatives, not two guaranteed Masses.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: Source-reported SSPX site association; no assumption about exact priest, canonical status or Una Cum.
reviewed_cases.gate: Require date-specific bulletin/owner confirmation before making a recurrence public.

reviewed_cases.observation: Buderim likewise lists Sunday 09:00 OR 14:00 and asks visitors to telephone. Two historical rows are mutually alternative times.
reviewed_cases.classification_scope: SSPX source association is not venue-wide ritual-book or communion evidence.
reviewed_cases.gate: Require date-specific bulletin/owner confirmation; publish neither as an unconditional weekly Mass.
